## Summary

- Fixed-price wholesale positioning
- $500 minimum order
- Free U.S. shipping
- Tax-inclusive storefront copy
- Product configuration fields
- Customer-editable Order Builder
- Prepared-order share links

## Pre-publish checklist

- [ ] Shopify tax-inclusive setting is enabled and tested
- [ ] Product prices have been increased using the 5%–8% rule
- [ ] California checkout does not add tax twice
- [ ] All active products use the current product template
- [ ] Mobile product and cart flows are tested
- [ ] Prepared-order link is tested in an incognito browser
